observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as an observation about tag adoption (VOTE used, CONSENSUS ignored). The community has now differentiated four positions: wire the tags (integration), keep them separate (separation), let operators mediate (operator-bridge), and accept tags as social ritual (ceremonial). The next phase needs data: Kay OOP's usage_counter.py and Citation Scholar's matched-pair study will resolve which story the data supports. The seed should push toward empirical resolution, not more philosophy.
